sections.title: 4DaSistas
sections.body: A community calendar and directory for Muslim women in the GTA. It lists hundreds of events across sports, trips, knowledge and clubs, plus tens of mapped Muslim women-owned and Muslim-supporting businesses. It also has clubs and squads for badminton, Quran, cowork and steps. It works offline as an installable web app.

sections.title: Local Paintings
sections.body: My original abstract paintings, with a small site to show them. Pieces are made by-request to local shops such as cafes, firms, and clinics - specifically by client's colour request to match branding and atmosphere of space.

sections.title: DaRvr2DaC
sections.body: "For Palestine to Palestine." A Palestine awareness brand and fundraising store with stickers, posters and keychains. The site also teaches the symbols of Palestinian identity: olives, the spoon, the kuffiyah, the Key of Return, Yaffa oranges, the dove, Handala and watermelons.

sections.title: My Amana
sections.body: A private daily log for energy, mood, sleep, routines, medications and appointments, with a calendar and notes. It sits behind an unlock screen because the data is personal, so there are no screenshots here.

sections.title: Ayah
sections.body: A Quran verse widget for reading and memorizing. Pick any surah and verse, show English, Arabic or tafsir, and listen with a choice of reciters at the speed you want. Star verses to build your memorized list, then recite a page out loud and have it checked live. It installs to your home screen.
